display.summary: Preserves system settings across section saves, partial imports, and concurrent app updates.
highlights: Saving one settings section preserves other sections, including stale or omitted hidden controls.
Partial imports keep unspecified settings and redacted SMTP credentials; full forms and snapshot restores retain explicit replacement semantics.
App settings merge into a locked current row so independent updates do not overwrite each other.
Boolean parsing is consistent across the catalogue; registered regressions cover every section and configuration group.
